Images were COPIED, never moved; nothing under ~/Developer/openai-data-archive was modified. proposedEntity and confidence are an AGENT PROPOSAL derived from the conversation text, not canon. Dates are EASTERN, converted from the export UTC epochs.
_meta.joinMethod: conversations-*.json -> mapping[*].message.content.parts[] where content_type=="image_asset_pointer" -> asset_pointer "sediment://<id>" or "file-service://<id>" -> "<id>.dat" on disk in the same archive dir. conversation_asset_file_names.json was verified as an id->original-filename map and is NOT needed for the conversation join.
